rationale: Fitted on experiment-1: insert() is always the worst cell (index maintenance offsets scan savings at small n). Measured insert gains: n=1000 -> 0.29, n=5000 -> 0.64, n=20000 -> 0.956. The unseen worst cell is insert@n=2000; interpolating base ~0.32ms and indexed ~0.185ms gives ~0.42. Experiment-1 taught me my min-cell estimates skew high (predicted 0.5, measured 0.29), so I shade the prediction down to 0.40. get() cells will all exceed this.
